{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the 'converted' status for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')
print(f'Conversion rate among refunded orders: {refunded_orders["converted"].mean():.4f}')

# Check the 'converted' status for non-refunded orders
non_refunded = df[df['status'] != 'refunded']
print(f'Conversion rate among non-refunded orders: {non_refunded["converted"].mean():.4f}')

# Check if 'converted' is 1 for refunded orders
print(f'Are any refunded orders converted? {refunded_orders["converted"].sum() > 0}')"}
